name: INVENTORY_IDENTIFIERS_V1
rules: SPR-########, LSU-######## and FT-######## use their own monotonic allocator kind and zero-padded decimal sequence; allocated sequence is never reused after correction or hard deletion

official Spare Request id is exactly SR followed by seven digits; C10 is exactly C followed by ten digits; canonical comparison is ordinal ASCII after trim and no case folding is needed because accepted form is uppercase
SR7/C10 assignment checks current and former alias tables globally; a former value is non-reusable
identifier correction preserves owning internal entity, demotes current alias to former and appends one new current alias in the same UnitOfWork
LSU is SOMA display identity for manual/legacy/extracted local units and never replaces spare_part_unit_id
BOM/serial normalization generates matching keys only; equality creates duplicate/reconciliation candidate and never identity merge
temporary tracking identity and official provider identity remain independently visible in history and communication matching
exhaustion: allocator next_sequence=100000000 is sentinel; allocation fails before any entity mutation
tests: same business identifier cannot select/merge a different internal entity
